stage1.impression: A dim, warm, well-composed wide view down a timber bar to a lit alcove where two red speakers glow. But the speakers read as neon signs: their edges are blown and hard. The near counter chairs look like smooth, pale, pinkish CG, and the right third falls into a featureless black slab. Surfaces have no 1:1 texture (no concrete formwork, fir checks or steel patina), and there is a second saturated hue (bottle green, plus a red slab lamp on the right). It reads as a competent hospitality render of a generic bar, not as a photograph of a specific place. A design magazine would not run it as Planet EARF: the zinc racetrack, fluted front, record wall and frosted screens are all illegible.

blocking_9: Speakers read as cast acrylic lit from within, not as neon: clip_pct inside each speaker box under 2 %, with the batts and horn readable through the tint
The room's signature elements are legible at a glance: the record wall on the left, the frosted screens on the right (hands, shell), the zinc top with its rounded edge and the fluted oak front
Materials hold at 1:1 at full 2400 px: board-formed concrete with tie holes and pour lines, fir checks, blackened steel patina, no smooth plastic upholstery
The smoked partition (right third) shows reflections and depth instead of a black void (lum_median >= 14)
Counter chairs read as dark oak, not blonde or pink timber
Visible pools of light repeat down the counter under each Dome, with dark between them
Signs of life read at proof scale: coat, glasses, record out of its sleeve
A little visible haze in the altar's spot beams

defects.what: left Ember speaker: 10.2 % clipped; the edge glow is a hard, saturated neon outline (edge step 116 over 1 px), so it reads as signage, not thick acrylic
right Ember speaker: 9.3 % clipped, same neon read
smoked partition and right-hand wall: a featureless near-black slab, median 8.3, a fifth of the frame with no information; one smeared red reflection
counter chairs read as pale, pinkish blonde wood with smooth, plastic-looking seats; the card says dark oak
the red Dome or slab lamp over the banquette table reads as a glossy red plastic block with blown pink edges, a second red hotspot that competes with the altar
the frosted screen or panel is barely legible (median 26.5, range 23): the shell in fog is a faint outline
the back bar and record wall are not readable as records: median 30, no sleeve highlights
the ceiling is flat, uniform planking (range 19); no Douglas fir beam character
the floor is mottled and blotchy, with a CG-looking noise pattern; as bright as the bar top (median 40 vs 36), so the pools of light do not separate
the altar alcove's back wall is dark and textureless, red-brown; the bottle-green booths add a second saturated colour, and the green cone shades over the speakers look like plastic
proof is 720 x 480 with visible denoiser smear on all wood grain; no people, so it is showroom-empty

changes.problem: The Ember pair blows out to a neon outline, so the hero reads as a sign, not as premium cast acrylic.

evidence.measured: clip_pct 10.2 (right speaker 9.3), lum_p95 184, edge step 116 over 1 px

change.setting: lamps: on each Ember speaker 4 x area (and the altar 2 x spot)
change.from: area 5.0 W/m2 at the target; altar spots 70.0 W, cone 28 deg
change.to: area 2.0 W/m2; altar spots 45 W, cone 36 deg, aimed to graze the cabinet faces from above rather than backlight the edges

changes.expected: The speakers keep their red glow but the edges stop clipping; the white batts and resin horn read through the tint; the speaker median stays at or above 45.

changes.problem: The frosted screens on the right and the panel on the left are nearly invisible, so the room's specific art is lost.

evidence.measured: median 26.5, range 23.4; right-hand screens inside [490,110,640,320] median 8.3

change.setting: the room's glowing surfaces: the screens' images

changes.expected: The screens glow softly and evenly with the hands and the shell legible; the right third gains a light source and stops being a void.

changes.problem: The counter chairs read as blonde or pink timber with smooth, plastic-looking seats, not dark oak.

evidence.measured: r 66 / g 37 / b 25, lum_p95 119: light warm-pink wood

change.to: a dark smoked oak, albedo about #3A2618, roughness 0.55, visible open grain (bump 0.3); seat leather given a micro-wrinkle normal and roughness 0.6

changes.expected: The chairs sit back into the room as dark furniture with highlights only on the curved back rails; the frame's warmth comes from the light, not the wood.

changes.problem: The record wall and back bar do not read as records.

change.setting: lamps: the record wall 4 x spot
change.to: 40 W, cone 30 deg, 2600 K, grazing down the spines

changes.expected: The sleeve spines pick up small coloured highlights, and the back bar becomes a legible wall of records.

changes.problem: The floor is as bright as the zinc, so there are no pools of light down the counter.

evidence.measured: floor median 39.6 vs bar top [0,265,200,320] median 36.3; bar-top profile drops from 129 to 29 within 200 px, so only the nearest Dome makes a pool

change.setting: lamps: the Domes' downlights 4 x spot; the floor's polish
change.from: 320.0 W, cone 46 deg; current floor sheen
change.to: 260 W, cone 30 deg (tight pools on the zinc); floor roughness up to 0.6 with a darker concrete tone

changes.expected: Each Dome throws a distinct pool on the zinc with dark between them; the floor drops to a quiet mid-dark.

changes.problem: The red lamp over the banquette table is a blown, glossy red block that competes with the altar as a second red hotspot.

evidence.measured: r 67 / g 25 / b 22, lum_p95 132, pink-white edge clip visible in the 4x crop

change.setting: EARF's lamps: each Dome's liner glow (the one over the banquette)

changes.expected: The lamp reads as a warm, quiet secondary glow, and the eye goes to the altar first.

changes.problem: No atmosphere: the altar spots and Domes make no visible beam, so the room reads as a clean CG volume.

evidence.measured: the air above the speakers has median 13.6, range 33, no gradient from the spots

changes.expected: Faint cones under the altar spots and the Domes, slightly lifted shadows above the speakers, the photographic night-bar air.

changes.problem: The props on the card (coat, coupe, record out of its sleeve, candles) are not legible, so the room reads unlived.

evidence.measured: the bar top shows two small glass shapes only; no coat or record visible in [0,320,300,480]

change.to: move the coat onto the nearest counter chair in frame, set a record out of its sleeve and the half-drunk coupe in the nearest Dome pool, and put a lit candle on the near banquette table

changes.expected: Two or three clear signs of life in the foreground pools.

out_of_scope.request: Lose the bottle-green booths and the green cone shades by the altar, so that red is the only saturated colour
out_of_scope.why: The zone and its colour (deep bottle green) and EARF's lamps are fixed by the card. Only their light can change.

out_of_scope.request: Swap the red cover on the Dome over the banquette for smoked
out_of_scope.why: The Dome's covers are part of EARF's product as specified; only its light level can change (c6).

out_of_scope.request: Give the shell real board-formed concrete with tie holes and pour lines, and Douglas fir beams with checks, on the ceiling and walls
out_of_scope.why: The tone and sheen are in scope, but the room's materials and geometry are fixed. If the current textures are what is specified, a new texture asset is a design decision for the owner.
This proof is at scale 0.3 (720 x 480); 1:1 material and denoiser judgements need the 2400 x 1600 frame.
